description: Check and apply upstream updates to installed skills. Reads pending-updates.json generated by the cron checker, spawns haiku agents to evaluate each diff for quality and safety, then spawns sonnet agents to apply smart merges — preserving local customizations while pulling in genuine upstream improvements. Triggers: /skill-update, "update skills", "check skill versions", "are my skills up to date"
